query:
SELECT m.sponsorId, s.companyName, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, m.matchScore, m.matchReason
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '452351'
ORDER BY m.timeSlot;
